task.notes: The test geometry one day shorter (E12.5 from E10.5, momentum from E9.5). The truth is the whole E10.5 library: 31% of it is pharyngeal, surrounding, progenitor or pericardial tissue (configs/t1_chamber_classes.yaml categories, measured 2026-11-01), while E12.5 is the heart chamber only.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

copy.what: real reference cells at the count rule

b0.what: B0 (feat-009): T1 chamber-only copy plus damped momentum; T2 copy plus damped momentum or bracket interpolation, both in count space

b0_xt.what: b0 on T1 with its momentum step realised by the exact-total kernel in its repair form: b0's independent draws, then per cell the excess or shortfall against the step's rounded expected total over the moved counts removed (hypergeometric) or added (multinomial at c f) (count space)

b0_scope.what: T1 chamber-only copy without a shift (B0's composition alone)

b0_half.what: b0 on T1 with a within-upload mixture: b0's momentum step on a uniformly random half of the drawn cells (the first n // 2 of the seeded draw order), the rest exactly as drawn (count space)

b0_half_ctrl.what: b0_half's count-mean-matched control (not matched in the scored log1p CP10k pseudobulk): every drawn cell moved, each entry by 1 + w (F - 1), F b0's factor after its keep-depth constant, w the share b0_half moves (1/2 for an even count) (count space)

b0_mn.what: b0 on T1 with its momentum step realised as a whole-cell multinomial redraw: each cell's moved counts redrawn together at the step's expected profile with the cell's rounded expected total (count space)
